ValidationRule.description: Developed as part of STY-00742 : To prevent users with profile other then Integration User, Data Migration and System Administrator from editing few fields on Contact created by Integration User.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.ContactValidations__c ) , NOT( CONTAINS( $User.NSP_Profile_Name__c , 'System Admin' ) ) , $User.NSP_Profile_Name__c <> 'Integration User' , $User.NSP_Profile_Name__c <> 'Data Migration' ,
OR ( CreatedBy.NSP_Profile_Name__c = 'Integration User', LastModifiedBy.NSP_Profile_Name__c = 'Integration User', NOT(ISBLANK(NSP_Per_ID__c)) ), OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(AccountId)), ISCHANGED(AccountId)),
AND(NOT(ISBLANK(FirstName)), ISCHANGED(FirstName)) ,
AND(NOT(ISBLANK(LastName)), ISCHANGED(LastName)) ,
ISCHANGED(MiddleName) ,
AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Salutation,'')), ISCHANGED(Salutation)) ,
AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Suffix)), ISCHANGED(Suffix)) ,
AND(NOT(ISBLANK(NSP_Preferred_First_Name__c)), ISCHANGED( NSP_Preferred_First_Name__c )) ,
AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(NSP_Employee_Status__c,'')), ISCHANGED( NSP_Employee_Status__c )) ,
AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(NSP_Gender__c,'')), ISCHANGED( NSP_Gender__c)) ,
AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(NSP_EEOC_Race_Code__c,'')), ISCHANGED(NSP_EEOC_Race_Code__c)),
AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(NSP_Employee_Identified_Gender__c,'')), ISCHANGED(NSP_Employee_Identified_Gender__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Contact integration fields are not editable.
